newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 2.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Wednesday stayed firm on strong cargo prices and crude gains, traders said. Traders said cargo prices have risen amid a firm crude market. They said bunker 380-cst was quoted at around $119.5 but rose to $122 later Wednesday. There were also some prompt demand, traders said. MDO were quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil stayed firm at $222-$228. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
